ex.zh: 工廠因違反安全規定被罰款。

ex.en: Workplace accidents must be reported immediately.
ex.zh: 職場意外必須立即通報。

ex.en: Fill out an injury report after any accident.
ex.zh: 任何意外後都要填寫受傷報告。

ex.en: Wear protective equipment in the lab.
ex.zh: 在實驗室請穿戴防護裝備。

ex.en: There is a fire extinguisher on every floor.
ex.zh: 每層樓都有滅火器。

ex.en: Keep the emergency exit clear.
ex.zh: 請保持緊急出口暢通。

ex.en: The evacuation was completed in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 疏散在十分鐘內完成。

ex.en: We have an evacuation drill twice a year.
ex.zh: 我們每年做兩次疏散演練。

ex.en: A hazard assessment was done before the work began.
ex.zh: 開工前做了危害評估。

ex.en: Every project needs a risk assessment.
ex.zh: 每個專案都需要風險評估。

ex.en: Preventive maintenance reduces breakdowns.
ex.zh: 預防性保養能減少故障。

ex.en: The elevator is closed for routine maintenance.
ex.zh: 電梯因例行保養暫停使用。

ex.en: The website will be down for scheduled maintenance.
ex.zh: 網站將因排定維護暫停服務。

ex.en: We need to reduce machine downtime.
ex.zh: 我們必須減少機器停機時間。

ex.en: The server has 99.9 percent uptime.
ex.zh: 伺服器運作時間達 99.9%。

ex.en: Repair work on the bridge will take a month.
ex.zh: 橋梁維修工程要一個月。

ex.en: Keep the spare parts inventory up to date.
ex.zh: 請隨時更新備品庫存。

ex.en: The machinery upgrade improved output.
ex.zh: 機械升級提高了產量。

ex.en: Equipment failure stopped the production line.
ex.zh: 設備故障讓產線停擺。

ex.en: Read the operating manual before using the machine.
ex.zh: 使用機器前請先讀操作手冊。

ex.en: Follow the standard operating procedure.
ex.zh: 請遵守標準作業程序。

ex.en: Lean manufacturing cuts waste.
ex.zh: 精實生產減少浪費。

ex.en: The new software brought big efficiency gains.
ex.zh: 新軟體帶來大幅效率提升。

ex.en: Output per hour has increased by 15 percent.
ex.zh: 每小時產量增加 15%。

ex.en: The new system increased throughput.
ex.zh: 新系統提高了處理量。

ex.en: Raw material costs rose this year.
ex.zh: 今年原物料成本上升。

ex.en: We changed our component supplier.
ex.zh: 我們換了零組件供應商。

ex.en: Our customer service is outsourced.
ex.zh: 我們的客服是外包的。

ex.en: We moved to in-house production.
ex.zh: 我們改為自行生產。

ex.en: The city has a large industrial area.
ex.zh: 這座城市有大型工業區。

ex.en: The factory is in an industrial park.
ex.zh: 工廠位於工業園區。

ex.en: Industrial waste must be handled carefully.
ex.zh: 工業廢棄物必須謹慎處理。

ex.en: The city improved its waste management.
ex.zh: 市政府改善了廢棄物管理。

ex.en: We studied the environmental impact of the project.
ex.zh: 我們研究了這專案的環境影響。

ex.en: New cars must meet strict emissions standards.
ex.zh: 新車必須符合嚴格的排放標準。

ex.en: The factory received ISO certification.
ex.zh: 工廠取得 ISO 認證。

ex.en: A compliance audit is scheduled for next month.
ex.zh: 下個月安排了合規稽核。

ex.en: Send the contract to the legal department.
ex.zh: 把合約送給法務部。

ex.en: Our legal counsel reviewed the agreement.
ex.zh: 我們的法律顧問審閱了協議。

ex.en: The in-house counsel handles most contracts.
ex.zh: 公司內部律師處理大部分合約。

ex.en: She works for a large law firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型律師事務所工作。

ex.en: Our legal team is reviewing the case.
ex.zh: 我們的法務團隊正在審查此案。

ex.en: Employers have a legal obligation to keep workers safe.
ex.zh: 雇主有法律義務保障員工安全。

ex.en: The customer threatened legal action.
ex.zh: 顧客揚言提告。

ex.en: The two companies are in a legal dispute.
ex.zh: 兩家公司陷入法律糾紛。

ex.en: The litigation lasted two years.
ex.zh: 這場訴訟持續了兩年。

ex.en: The dispute was settled through arbitration.
ex.zh: 糾紛透過仲裁解決。

ex.en: Both sides agreed to mediation.
ex.zh: 雙方同意調解。

ex.en: A mediator helped them reach an agreement.
ex.zh: 調解人幫助他們達成協議。

ex.en: The arbitrator's decision is final.
ex.zh: 仲裁人的決定是最終的。

ex.en: The court case will be heard next month.
ex.zh: 這案件下個月開庭。

ex.en: The plaintiff asked for $1 million in damages.
ex.zh: 原告要求一百萬美元賠償。

ex.en: The defendant denied all charges.
ex.zh: 被告否認所有指控。

ex.en: The jury reached a verdict.
ex.zh: 陪審團作出裁決。

ex.en: The court's ruling favored the company.
ex.zh: 法院的裁定對公司有利。

ex.en: The company will appeal the decision.
ex.zh: 公司將對判決提出上訴。

ex.en: Both parties signed a settlement agreement.
ex.zh: 雙方簽署和解協議。

ex.en: They reached an out-of-court settlement.
ex.zh: 他們達成庭外和解。

ex.en: This is a binding agreement for both sides.
ex.zh: 這是對雙方有約束力的協議。

ex.en: The letter of intent is nonbinding.
ex.zh: 意向書不具約束力。

ex.en: The two firms signed a memorandum of understanding.
ex.zh: 兩家公司簽署合作備忘錄。

ex.en: We sent a letter of intent to buy the property.
ex.zh: 我們寄出購買房產的意向書。

ex.en: Visitors must sign a nondisclosure agreement.
ex.zh: 訪客必須簽保密協議。

ex.en: All staff signed a confidentiality agreement.
ex.zh: 所有員工都簽了保密協議。

ex.en: The service agreement covers repairs for two years.
ex.zh: 服務合約涵蓋兩年維修。

ex.en: We signed a licensing agreement to use the brand.
ex.zh: 我們簽了品牌授權協議。

ex.en: You may not sublease the apartment.
ex.zh: 你不得轉租這間公寓。

ex.en: Please review the contract terms carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細檢閱合約條款。

ex.en: The contract period is three years.
ex.zh: 合約期間為三年。

ex.en: Contract renewal is due in December.
ex.zh: 十二月要續約。

ex.en: Contract termination requires 60 days' notice.
ex.zh: 終止合約需提前 60 天通知。
